$comment: What on a page is the platform, and what is somebody's private content.
private: elements holding other people's content - a message, a conversation, a post,
a comment, a notification, a contact, a profile picture. They are greyed out unless
the tutorial is about them. List the smallest unit that makes sense on its own (one
conversation, not the whole list): whatever the tutorial touches keeps its whole
unit, and the rest of the list stays greyed out.
hidden: clutter removed from the picture altogether, such as an account chooser
prompts: dialogs answered on the viewer's behalf - container is where to look, text
what the dialog says, dismiss the label of the button to press, path an optional
address pattern the rule is limited to. text, dismiss and path are regular
expressions, matched without regard to case.
generic applies on every site. It relies on the labels a page gives screen readers -
a region named 'Chats' or 'Notifications', a feed, a log - which large platforms
keep stable far longer than their class names. The platform entries add what those
labels miss. Selectors on class names (LinkedIn, Gmail, Slack, Telegram) are the
least durable and the first to check when something shows through.

private.name: conversations, messages, notifications and contacts
private.selector: :is(div, section, aside, ul, ol, table, [role="grid"], [role="list"], [role="listbox"], [role="tree"], [role="region"], [role="dialog"], [role="complementary"]):is([aria-label*="chat" i], [aria-label*="conversation" i], [aria-label*="message" i], [aria-label*="inbox" i], [aria-label*="notification" i], [aria-label*="contact" i], [aria-label*="nachricht" i], [aria-label*="unterhaltung" i], [aria-label*="benachrichtigung" i], [aria-label*="kontakt" i], [aria-label*="posteingang" i]) :is([role="row"], [role="listitem"], [role="option"], [role="article"], [role="treeitem"], li, tr)

private.name: profile pictures
private.selector: img:is([alt*="profile picture" i], [alt*="profile photo" i], [alt*="profilbild" i], [alt*="avatar" i], [class*="avatar" i])
